newsitem.title: USA: Fred Meyer files for 3.78 mln common shrs.
newsitem.headline: Fred Meyer files for 3.78 mln common shrs.

text.p: Fred Meyer Inc filed Thursday with the Securities and Exchange Commission a secondary offering for up to 3.78 million common shares.
The shares will be sold by FMI Associates L.P., an affiliate of Kholberg Kravis Roberts & Co L.P., which currently holds a stake of 37.8 percent or 10.7 million shares, according to the filing.
With the consummation of the offering, Fred Meyer will repurchase 2.2 million common shares valued at $70 million from FMI.

Following completion of the offering and the stock repurchase, FMI will own about 18.1 percent or 4.72 million common shares in Fred Meyer, assuming no exercise of underwriters' overallotment options.
The options, totalling 420,000 additional shares, were granted to a group led by Goldman, Sachs & Co, which is underwriting the offering.
Fred Meyer will not receive any of the proceeds from the sale.
